tools.name: list_integrations
tools.description: List Orbilyn channel integrations (metadata only, no secrets).

tools.name: list_mismatches
tools.description: List mismatches from a comparison run (latest if runId omitted).

tools.name: get_monitoring_alerts
tools.description: Get unread Monitoring alerts (new mismatches from scheduled runs).

tools.name: find_product
tools.description: Find a product by SKU and/or EAN with stock and price per channel.

tools.name: get_comparison_summary
tools.description: Summaries of recent comparison / history runs (counts, labels).

tools.name: catalog_health_score
tools.description: Catalog health score 0–100 with breakdown: photos, descriptions, prices, stock, duplicates, channel_consistency. Uses the latest comparison run (or setId) plus Overview media signals. Example: {"setId":"<uuid>"}.

tools.name: list_critical_issues
tools.description: List CatalogIssue rows sorted by impact (severity then type). Default severity=critical. Supports limit + offset pagination. Example: {"limit":20,"offset":0,"severity":"critical"}. Issue shape: sku, channel, type, severity, current, expected, suggested_action, detected_at, source_id, set_id.

tools.name: prepare_fix_list
tools.description: Prepare a CatalogIssue fix list as JSON (default) or CSV. Same schema as list_critical_issues. Example JSON: {"format":"json","limit":50}. Example CSV: {"format":"csv","severity":"all"}.

tools.name: ai_readiness_report
tools.description: Shopping-agent readiness: catalog products agents would reject (missing GTIN/EAN, photos, description, attributes, price/stock) plus what to fill in. Shared CatalogIssue format. Every result includes rules_version, audit_date, checked_fields, profile (google_merchant). Example: {"profile":"google_me

tools.name: explain_issue
tools.description: Per SKU: what shopping-agent readiness checks failed and why. Same meta envelope (rules_version, audit_date, checked_fields, profile) + CatalogIssue list + explanations. Example: {"sku":"SKU-100"}.

tools.name: get_webhook_config
tools.description: Read Scale webhook subscription (URL, enabled, event catalog). Signing: X-Orbilyn-Signature HMAC-SHA256. Webhook sample items use the CatalogIssue schema (sku + type preserved; additive fields).

tools.name: configure_webhook
tools.description: Configure outbound webhook URL/secret (requires write scope). Events: catalog.duplicate.new, catalog.drift.status, sync.failure, monitoring.*.

tools.name: run_monitoring
tools.description: Trigger a Monitoring compare run now (requires action scope).

tools.name: start_catalog_audit
tools.description: Start a catalog audit over persisted comparison/Overview data (no live re-import; safe for large catalogs). Returns auditId + status. Result uses shared CatalogIssue format. Webhook: audit.completed. Requires action scope.

tools.name: get_audit_status
tools.description: Poll async catalog audit status by auditId (pending|running|succeeded|failed).

tools.name: get_audit_result
tools.description: Fetch catalog audit result (CatalogIssue list + health). Paginate with limit/offset. Fails if audit is still pending/running.

tools.name: create_monitor
tools.description: Create a Scale Monitoring pair (Alerty/Automatyzacja). Params: sources, thresholds, issueTypes, actions (webhook|email|fix_list). Write scope.

tools.name: update_monitor
tools.description: Update an existing Monitoring pair (thresholds, sources, actions, enabled). Write scope.

tools.name: pause_monitor
tools.description: Pause (disable) a Monitoring pair. Write scope.

tools.name: list_monitors
tools.description: List Scale Monitoring pairs configured for this account.

tools.name: get_monitor_history
tools.description: Monitoring run history with deltas vs previous run (new / fixed / open) and CatalogIssue samples.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_critical_issues, explain_issue, get_webhook_config · Private data: list_integrations, configure_webhook · Public sink: get_webhook_config, configure_webhook, start_catalog_audit, create_monitor · Destructive: list_mismatches, catalog_health_score, prepare_fix_list, ai_readiness_report, run_monitoring, start_catalog_audit, get_monitor_history.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_critical_issues, explain_issue, get_webhook_config · Private data: list_integrations, configure_webhook · Public sink: get_webhook_config, configure_webhook, start_catalog_audit, create_monitor · Destructive: list_mismatches, catalog_health_score, prepare_fix_list, ai_readiness_report, run_monitoring, start_catalog_audit, get_monitor_history

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
